# Remote Work Policy
# Purpose
This memo sets out how Example Widgets Inc. supports remote work for its 120 staff.
## Scope
The policy covers all full-time employees.[1]
Eligible roles include:
- Engineering
  - Platform services
    - On-call rotation excluded
- Finance
## Approval steps
1. Submit a request form
2. Manager signs off within five days
  1. Escalations go to the operations lead
### Equipment
Table: Table 1: Equipment allowance
| Item | Allowance |
| --- | --- |
| Laptop | $1,500 |
| Monitor | $300 |
Office days per tier are listed below.
| Team | Office days |
| Support | See tiers:; Tier; Days; A; 3 |
## Architecture overview
[image #d7804607-img-1: "Office network diagram"]
Contact IT for exceptions
> Remote work is a privilege, not a right.
## Notes
1. Contractors follow their own agreement.
